properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.3 (SHA-1/SHA-2/RIPEMD digests) declared in package-lock.json — used transitively by elliptic's curve utilities and the crypto-browserify family. No direct src/ call site; records what the bundle ships. Cross-reference: the library object is LIB-e966a74e (hash.js).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: App's password breach check: SHA-1 over the candidate password feeds the HIBP Pwned-Passwords k-anonymity lookup (only the 5-char hash prefix is sent to api.pwnedpasswords.com). NIST SP 800-63B explicitly permits this pattern; no password verifier or stored hash is produced, so the Argon2id migration does not apply here — purpose recorded, kept.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: secp256k1 ECDSA is the Ethereum signing curve and the app's core signature primitive — keypairs for EOA/identity signers, in-browser via ethers, and on hardware (Ledger/Trezor/Lattice). The curve itself is fixed by the EVM ecosystem (observable here, replaceable only ecosystem-wide); the dependency choice is changeable here. Deadline risk under Shor, not harvest-now-decrypt-later.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: browserify's EVP_BytesToKey port (single-round MD5 KDF) shipped inside the crypto-browserify shim used by Ethereum tooling; available API surface, no password input path in application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: OpenBSD bcrypt_pbkdf KDF shipped in the tree (tweetnacl-adjacent/keystore paths); memory-hard and PQ-appropriate where used.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency inventory: Poly1305 MAC available in the shipped bundle via tweetnacl secretbox/@stablelib; no separate application call site.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hygiene finding, not a keygen break: ethers Wallet.createRandom draws 128 bits from a CSPRNG as primary entropy; the weak string is folded through keccak256, so mnemonic strength stays at 128 bits. Worth cleaning up, kept for review.

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
